purpose: Make cross-chat continuity observable to the user and mechanically honest about persisted progress.

resume_progress_receipt.name: Resume Progress Receipt
resume_progress_receipt.trigger: after exact task selection and authoritative checkpoint read, before substantive resumed work
resume_progress_receipt.snapshot_boundary: capture the authoritative persisted state before the new-chat lease/takeover mutates resume_epoch or active_lease
rules: Never reconstruct pre-resume progress from chat memory when authoritative state exists.
Do not claim completed work that is absent from the authoritative checkpoint.
Show the receipt before substantive continuation so the user can see where the task was actually left.
If the task is WAITING or BLOCKED, surface the waiting/blocker reason explicitly.
If required state is unavailable, fail closed instead of inventing a progress summary.

intra_turn_safe_checkpointing.purpose: Prevent recoverable material progress from existing only in chat until the final response. Long-running durable work must survive abrupt context exhaustion, disconnects, tool interruption, or chat termination by persisting verified safe points during the turn.
intra_turn_safe_checkpointing.activation: while a durable task is active and a stable material progress boundary is reached before the final user-facing response
safe_point_triggers: a durable stage, next_action, blocker, waiting state, authority/version decision, or material requirement becomes stable
a material artifact or authoritative state mutation succeeds and its postcondition is verified
an external side effect or irreversible action succeeds and later work depends on it
before entering another long, high-risk, or tool-heavy subphase when already completed material progress would otherwise be lost
after recovering from a failure when a truthful stable partial state exists and later work will continue

rules.checkpoint_before_more_work: Once a safe-point trigger is reached, persist the smallest sufficient authoritative checkpoint and re-read/verify it before continuing substantial downstream work. Do not intentionally defer the first durable write until the final response when stable material progress already exists.
rules.consistent_state_only: Checkpoint only internally consistent, truthfully recoverable state. Do not publish speculative conclusions, half-applied migrations, or an artifact set whose authority relationships are known to be temporarily contradictory unless the checkpoint explicitly records the truthful BLOCKED/IN_PROGRESS recovery state.
rules.lease_guard: Verify the current writer lease/epoch before any checkpoint write. If stale, stop the checkpoint and surface STALE_WRITER rather than overwriting newer authority.
rules.new_chat_recovery: A replacement chat must be able to resume from the latest verified safe checkpoint without requiring the terminated chat transcript to reconstruct completed material work.
rules.mid_turn_checkpoint_is_not_final_receipt: Mid-turn safe checkpoints do not replace the final Turn Commit Receipt; the final response still reports the current durable state once per active durable task.
rules.no_micro_heartbeat: Pure reads, transient diagnostics, reversible scratch work, unchanged state, and unverified hypotheses do not require writes. Group related low-level operations into meaningful safe points.

turn_commit_receipt.name: Turn Commit Receipt
turn_commit_receipt.trigger: every final user-facing response while a durable task is active

rules.material_change: If the turn changes stage, next_action, blocker/waiting state, authority/version context, durable decision, or material artifact state, persistence is required before the final response.
rules.no_material_change: Do not create meaningless heartbeat writes. Report NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE and state the unchanged durable resume point.
rules.committed: COMMITTED may be reported only after the write succeeded and the authoritative state was re-read/verified. A tool success without re-read is insufficient.
rules.failed: If material progress should have been persisted but the write or verification fails, report COMMIT_FAILED and explicitly state that the new progress may not survive the next chat.
rules.stale_writer: If the current lease/epoch no longer matches, report STALE_WRITER and do not checkpoint.
rules.external_owner: When business state is owned outside the universal repository, verification must use that owner's authoritative version/checkpoint rather than pretending a Universal cache write proves business persistence.

assurance_separation.rule: A task must be able to persist the truthful fact that an execution/methodology/quality gate is still OPEN or BLOCKED. Missing higher-assurance evidence blocks that gate or completion claim, not the ability to checkpoint the blocker itself. Report the assurance/gate state separately from COMMITTED.
